rationale: The stock is trading at 97.1% of its intraday range with only 52 minutes to close, sitting just $0.07 below the session high after a massive gap-up on earnings — momentum is extended and risk/reward for a long is poor this late in the session. A short against the trend with this much upward momentum and high relative volume (10.91x) is equally dangerous. The broad market is under significant pressure (SPY -2.28%, VIXY +14.89%), which adds macro headwind uncertainty, and the last few 1-minute candles show indecision near the high rather than a clean continuation or reversal signal sufficient to justify entry.
